import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { View } from 'react-native'
import { AppText } from '../src/components/AppText'
import { Button } from '../src/components/Button'
import { Card } from '../src/components/Card'
import { EmptyState } from '../src/components/EmptyState'
import { Screen } from '../src/components/Screen'
import { Skeleton } from '../src/components/Skeleton'
import { useI18n } from '../src/i18n'
import { useSupabase } from '../src/lib/supabase/provider'
import { type Palette, radius, space, useThemedStyles } from '../src/theme/theme'

// The sign-in methods route: every identity linked to this account (the email identity, and
// each provider a user linked), read from the auth server. Read-only here: linking and
// unlinking are a web flow.
// The data-state test ids, the same three src/routes.ts declares for this route.
const STATES = {
  loading: 'identities-loading',
  empty: 'identities-empty',
  error: 'identities-error',
} as const

interface IdentityRow {
  readonly id: string
  readonly provider: string
  readonly email: string | null
}

type IdentitiesState =
  | { readonly status: 'loading' }
  | { readonly status: 'error' }
  | { readonly status: 'ready'; readonly identities: readonly IdentityRow[] }

/** The address an identity carries, when its provider recorded one as a string. */
function emailOf(data: Record<string, unknown> | undefined): string | null {
  const email = data?.['email']
  return typeof email === 'string' ? email : null
}

const identityStyles = (palette: Palette) => ({
  row: {
    backgroundColor: palette.canvas,
    borderColor: palette.edge,
    borderRadius: radius.sm,
    borderWidth: 1,
    gap: space[1],
    paddingHorizontal: space[3],
    paddingVertical: space[2],
  },
  list: {
    gap: space[2],
  },
})

export default function IdentitiesScreen() {
  const { t } = useI18n()
  const supabase = useSupabase()
  const styles = useThemedStyles(identityStyles)
  const [state, setState] = useState<IdentitiesState>({ status: 'loading' })
  // Bumping this re-runs the read: the effect keys on intent (mount, retry), and every
  // setState happens in the resolve callback, never synchronously in the effect body.
  const [reloadToken, setReloadToken] = useState(0)

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false
    void supabase.auth.getUserIdentities().then(({ data, error }) => {
      // A stale resolve must not write state over a newer load's result.
      if (cancelled) return
      if (error !== null) {
        setState({ status: 'error' })
        return
      }
      setState({
        status: 'ready',
        identities: data.identities.map((identity) => ({
          id: identity.identity_id,
          provider: identity.provider,
          email: emailOf(identity.identity_data),
        })),
      })
    })
    return () => {
      cancelled = true
    }
  }, [supabase, reloadToken])

  const reload = (): void => {
    setState({ status: 'loading' })
    setReloadToken((token) => token + 1)
  }

  return (
    <Screen testID="identities-screen">
      <AppText variant="title">{t('route.identities')}</AppText>
      <AppText variant="muted">{t('identities.body')}</AppText>
      <IdentitiesBody state={state} styles={styles} onRetry={reload} />
    </Screen>
  )
}

// The three canonical states, split out so each surface stays small enough to read.
function IdentitiesBody({
  state,
  styles,
  onRetry,
}: {
  readonly state: IdentitiesState
  readonly styles: ReturnType<typeof identityStyles>
  readonly onRetry: () => void
}) {
  const { t } = useI18n()
  if (state.status === 'loading') {
    // A skeleton that mirrors the rows about to paint, announced as a progressbar.
    return <Skeleton lines={2} testID={STATES.loading} />
  }
  if (state.status === 'error') {
    return (
      // The error test id sits on a surface CONTAINING its retry.
      <Card tone="danger" testID={STATES.error}>
        <AppText variant="label" role="alert">
          {t('identities.error.title')}
        </AppText>
        <Button variant="outline" label={t('common.retry')} onPress={onRetry} />
      </Card>
    )
  }
  if (state.identities.length === 0) {
    return (
      <EmptyState
        testID={STATES.empty}
        title={t('identities.empty.title')}
        description={t('identities.empty.description')}
        cta={{ label: t('common.retry'), onPress: onRetry }}
      />
    )
  }
  return (
    <View style={styles.list}>
      {state.identities.map((identity) => (
        // One element per row: the provider and the address announce together, and the row
        // holds no control a grouped container could swallow.
        <View
          key={identity.id}
          style={styles.row}
          accessible
          accessibilityLabel={[identity.provider, identity.email].filter(Boolean).join(', ')}
          testID="identities-row"
        >
          <AppText variant="label">{identity.provider}</AppText>
          {identity.email === null ? null : <AppText variant="muted">{identity.email}</AppText>}
        </View>
      ))}
    </View>
  )
}
